This is not byte-equivalence or shared-scratch/reentrancy proof. Do not revert real pixel behavior to the former edge-setup-only stub to preserve a spelling score.

Directed64-significand reciprocal/multiply slopes require the adjusted integer quotient, not direct division. Preserve acquisition-before-state reads and release-before-final FNINIT-equivalent reset; ordinary C runtime FPU controls avoid product assembly. Original intermediate inexact flags observable inside an inspecting Unlock callback are not reproduced by integer arithmetic.

Ordinary convex screen polygons have positive representable edge/span16.16 values and fixed_div quotients, with positive stride and signed-address row order unwrapped. Huge positive spans can reuse preceding calls shared slopes; signed IDIV overflow traps and wrapped row-address comparisons remain exceptional-domain obligations. No new matching regression or full-function acceptance is granted by this decision.
